body: 第一张图是深绿水磨石材质，第二张是目标客厅。仅把目标图中可见的浅橡木地板替换成第一张的深绿色水磨石，匹配纹理尺度、透视和光影。保留沙发、桌子、花瓶、地毯、落地灯、窗、门、墙、相机角度和构图完全不变。不改变地毯，不添加物品。4:3。

en.description: Only the visible floor becomes green terrazzo; the rug, furniture, door and window retain their positions and shapes.
en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

Only the visible floor becomes green terrazzo; the rug, furniture, door and window retain their positions and shapes.

## Source
